description: Browse or search MyAnimeList Interest Stacks: themed anime/manga lists curated by real users, each entry carrying the curator's own score and note. Use this for taste- or mood-shaped requests ('something melancholy', 'cozy slice-of-life') where a ranking or a genre filter is the wrong instrument — get_top_anime answers 'what is best', this answers 'what goes together'. Returns stack metadata only; pass a stack's mal_id to get_interest_stack for its actual entries. For stacks containing one specific title, use get_anime_interest_stacks/get_manga_interest_stacks instead. No official-API fallback exists for this tool — it always needs Tenrai itself to be reachable.

challenges.description: Filter by challenge stacks (watch-along style lists). 'true' includes them alongside the rest (default), 'false' excludes them, 'only' returns exclusively those.

official.description: Filter by official MAL-editorial stacks. 'true' includes them alongside the rest (default), 'false' excludes them, 'only' returns exclusively those.

order_by.description: Field to order by. Defaults to created_at (newest stacks first).

q.description: Free-text search over stack titles and descriptions. Omit to browse all.

sfw.description: If true, exclude adult/explicit-rated entries (R+ Mild Nudity and up). Defaults to false (no filtering). Note: this alone still allows mainstream, safely-rated shows tagged with the Ecchi genre (fanservice) through — use `sfw_strict` to also exclude those.

sfw_strict.description: If true, exclude adult/explicit-rated entries AND anything tagged with the Ecchi genre, even otherwise-mainstream/safely-rated shows. Stricter than `sfw` alone. Defaults to false.

spoilers.description: Filter by stacks flagged as containing spoilers. 'true' includes them alongside the rest (default), 'false' excludes them, 'only' returns exclusively those.

stack_type.description: Restrict to anime stacks or manga stacks. Omit for both.

name: get_interest_stacks
title: Browse interest stacks
